title: A Detention for the Yearbook
author: Xanthe Fairweather
blurb: Rosalind Almeida, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
